name: Banjarnegara

queries.query: Banjarnegara Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR/BPN BHUMI Geoserver API; Banjarnegara land office parcel data
queries.result: First-party discovery identified BHUMI ATR/BPN, integrated with the official ATLAS geoportal, as the public spatial viewer. Its official help page describes parcel layers and parcel information, while the official Banjarnegara government reports the local Kantor Pertanahan and Peta Bidang Tanah/land-registration work. No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was qualified.

queries.query: peta bidang tanah Banjarnegara resmi ATR BPN Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Banjarnegara BHUMI layanan geospasial
queries.result: Indonesian-language first-party discovery confirmed Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Banjarnegara as the local cadastral custodian and found official local-government references to PTSL, Peta Bidang Tanah, and land-zone mapping. BHUMI documentation states that the parcel layer is public-facing, but the live anonymous service did not return a usable parcel feature response.
